INSERT INTO courses (languageId, language_id, title, description, level, isPublished, createdAt, updatedAt) VALUES (1, 1, 'English for Beginners', 'Learn English from scratch with fun stories and exercises', 'beginner', 1, NOW(), NOW());

INSERT INTO lessons (courseId, title, description, orderIndex, storyText, illustrationUrl, ageLevel, languageCode, estimatedMinutes, createdAt, updatedAt) VALUES
(1, 'Hello World', 'Learn basic greetings', 1, 'Meet Sarah! She is 8 years old. Every morning, Sarah says "Hello!" to her family. Her mom says "Good morning, Sarah!" Her dad says "Hello, sweetheart!" Sarah smiles and says "Good morning!" back.', 'https://files.manuscdn.com/user_upload_by_module/session_file/310519663082627627/mWocoqWXXuxvwexQ.png', 'infantil', 'en', 15, NOW(), NOW()),
(1, 'My Family', 'Learn about family members', 2, 'This is Tom. He has a big family! Tom has a mom, a dad, one brother named Jack, and one sister named Emma. They all live together in a yellow house. Tom loves his family very much!', 'https://files.manuscdn.com/user_upload_by_module/session_file/310519663082627627/mWocoqWXXuxvwexQ.png', 'infantil', 'en', 15, NOW(), NOW()),
(1, 'Colors Around Us', 'Learn color names', 3, 'Lucy loves colors! She looks at the sky - it is blue. She looks at the sun - it is yellow. The grass in her garden is green. Her favorite toy is a red ball. What colors do you see?', 'https://files.manuscdn.com/user_upload_by_module/session_file/310519663082627627/ZYbJNJOQZJkWBeWp.png', 'infantil', 'en', 15, NOW(), NOW()),
(1, 'At the Restaurant', 'Ordering food', 4, 'Mike goes to a restaurant with his friends. The waiter asks "What would you like to order?" Mike says "I would like a burger and fries, please." His friend orders a pizza. They enjoy their meal together.', 'https://files.manuscdn.com/user_upload_by_module/session_file/310519663082627627/gjVIXQvOvDTIOrrT.png', 'adolescente', 'en', 20, NOW(), NOW()),
(1, 'School Life', 'School vocabulary', 5, 'Emma goes to high school. Her favorite subject is math because she loves solving problems. She also enjoys art class where she can paint and draw. After school, Emma studies in the library with her classmates.', 'https://files.manuscdn.com/user_upload_by_module/session_file/310519663082627627/THiATiJSYxVBdKlW.png', 'adolescente', 'en', 20, NOW(), NOW()),
(1, 'Business Meeting', 'Professional English', 6, 'Mr. Johnson presents the quarterly sales report to the board of directors. He explains that revenue increased by 15% this quarter. The team discusses strategies to maintain this growth in the coming months.', 'https://files.manuscdn.com/user_upload_by_module/session_file/310519663082627627/iSufIsZYracWclTF.png', 'adulto', 'en', 25, NOW(), NOW()),
(1, 'Stock Market Basics', 'Trading terminology', 7, 'Trading stocks requires knowledge and strategy. Investors analyze market trends, evaluate company performance, and make informed decisions. Understanding terms like "bull market" and "bear market" is essential for success.', 'https://files.manuscdn.com/user_upload_by_module/session_file/310519663082627627/PSdKQJPDoVCZrkrX.png', 'adulto', 'en', 30, NOW(), NOW()),
(1, 'Scientific Research', 'Scientific vocabulary', 8, 'Dr. Smith conducts research in molecular biology. She uses advanced laboratory equipment to study cellular processes. Her recent findings on protein synthesis have been published in a prestigious scientific journal.', 'https://files.manuscdn.com/user_upload_by_module/session_file/310519663082627627/YubjWYLDinMTWdMO.png', 'adulto', 'en', 30, NOW(), NOW()),
(1, 'Travel Adventures', 'Travel phrases', 9, 'Anna travels to Paris for summer vacation. She visits the Eiffel Tower, explores local museums, and tries authentic French cuisine. She practices her French with locals and makes new friends along the way.', 'https://files.manuscdn.com/user_upload_by_module/session_file/310519663082627627/tDYhbbxwwXuxprgF.png', 'adolescente', 'en', 20, NOW(), NOW()),
(1, 'Health and Fitness', 'Health vocabulary', 10, 'John exercises three times a week at the gym. He combines cardio workouts with strength training. His fitness coach helps him create a balanced nutrition plan to achieve his health goals.', 'https://files.manuscdn.com/user_upload_by_module/session_file/310519663082627627/YubjWYLDinMTWdMO.png', 'adolescente', 'en', 20, NOW(), NOW());
